generator.across_seed_summary: median, mean, IQR, and observed range; Run_L query incidence uses mean

metric_definitions.activation_percent: Bioseq natural sequential shadow at the configured D: 100 * searches where the strict drop predicate fired / executed backtracking searches
metric_definitions.avoided_visits_per_check: Bioseq natural sequential shadow at the configured D: sum(natural predecessor visits - shadow-limited predecessor visits) / sum(executed max-drop checks), computed within each seed first
metric_definitions.mean_path_visit_reduction_percent: Bioseq natural sequential shadow at the configured D: 100 * sum over searches of (natural-limited)/natural / executed searches; zero-natural-length searches contribute zero
metric_definitions.minimap_policy_avoided_visits_per_check: finite minimap replay only: locally saved visits / finite scan steps
metric_definitions.minimap_policy_productive_trigger_percen: finite minimap replay only: 100 * productive finite-drop searches / executed searches
metric_definitions.minimap_policy_visit_reduction_percent: finite minimap replay only: 100 * locally saved visits / entry-state natural visits
metric_definitions.productive_trigger_percent: Bioseq natural sequential shadow at the configured D: 100 * positive-saving searches / executed backtracking searches
metric_definitions.runl16_coverage_percent: 100 * predecessor anchors covered by Run_16 fast batches / anchors on the top-ranked predecessor path
metric_definitions.runl16_fire_percent: 100 * Run_16 fast batches / Run_16 loop evaluations on the top-ranked path
metric_definitions.runl16_ideal_loop_reduction_percent: 100 * (scalar top-path iterations - mixed Run_16 loop evaluations) / scalar top-path iterations; this is an ideal algorithmic loop-count reduction, not timed speedup
metric_definitions.runl16_query_incidence_percent: Across-input percentage of queries with a ranked end that have at least one Run_16 fast batch; aggregate using the mean of per-input 0/100 indicators; undefined when no ranked end exists
metric_definitions.runl4_coverage_percent: 100 * predecessor anchors covered by Run_4 fast batches / anchors on the top-ranked predecessor path
metric_definitions.runl4_fire_percent: 100 * Run_4 fast batches / Run_4 loop evaluations on the top-ranked path
metric_definitions.runl4_ideal_loop_reduction_percent: 100 * (scalar top-path iterations - mixed Run_4 loop evaluations) / scalar top-path iterations; this is an ideal algorithmic loop-count reduction, not timed speedup
metric_definitions.runl4_query_incidence_percent: Across-input percentage of queries with a ranked end that have at least one Run_4 fast batch; aggregate using the mean of per-input 0/100 indicators; undefined when no ranked end exists
metric_definitions.runl8_coverage_percent: 100 * predecessor anchors covered by Run_8 fast batches / anchors on the top-ranked predecessor path
metric_definitions.runl8_fire_percent: 100 * Run_8 fast batches / Run_8 loop evaluations on the top-ranked path
metric_definitions.runl8_ideal_loop_reduction_percent: 100 * (scalar top-path iterations - mixed Run_8 loop evaluations) / scalar top-path iterations; this is an ideal algorithmic loop-count reduction, not timed speedup
metric_definitions.runl8_query_incidence_percent: Across-input percentage of queries with a ranked end that have at least one Run_8 fast batch; aggregate using the mean of per-input 0/100 indicators; undefined when no ranked end exists
metric_definitions.simd16_critical_path_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 16: 100 * saved whole-backtrack critical steps / baseline whole-backtrack critical steps
metric_definitions.simd16_lane_work_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 16: 100 * paired max-drop saved lane visits / baseline active lane visits
metric_definitions.simd16_paired_physical_lane_utilization_: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 16: 100 * paired active lane steps / paired full-width scheduled lane slots
metric_definitions.simd4_critical_path_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 4: 100 * saved whole-backtrack critical steps / baseline whole-backtrack critical steps
metric_definitions.simd4_lane_work_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 4: 100 * paired max-drop saved lane visits / baseline active lane visits
metric_definitions.simd4_paired_physical_lane_utilization_p: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 4: 100 * paired active lane steps / paired full-width scheduled lane slots
metric_definitions.simd8_critical_path_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 8: 100 * saved whole-backtrack critical steps / baseline whole-backtrack critical steps
metric_definitions.simd8_lane_work_reduction_percent: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 8: 100 * paired max-drop saved lane visits / baseline active lane visits
metric_definitions.simd8_paired_physical_lane_utilization_p: Bioseq SIMD shadow at width 8: 100 * paired active lane steps / paired full-width scheduled lane slots
metric_definitions.visit_reduction_percent: Bioseq natural sequential shadow at the configured D: 100 * sum(natural predecessor visits - shadow-limited predecessor visits) / sum(natural predecessor visits), computed within each seed first

selection.n5000_handling: excluded from primary heatmaps; plotted separately

reasons: 5000 non-overlapping copies of a 997--1002-base query do not fit in an exactly 4.5-Mbp reference; this is not encoded as zero
structural_n5000.statement: 4.5-Mbp primary N=5000: structurally infeasible (246 seed×divergence records); never encoded as zero.
